test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Numerical Ability (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: In a circular race on a track of length 2000 m, X and Y start from the same point at the same time in opposite direction at the speeds of 15 km/h and 33 km / h, respectively. After how much time will they meet next?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the circular track = 2000 m = 2 km

Speed of X = 15 km/h

Speed of Y = 33 km/h

**Formula used:**

Time to meet = Distance / Relative speed

**Calculation:**

Relative speed = 15 + 33 = 48 km/h (since they are moving in opposite directions)

Time to meet = 2 / 48 = 1/24 hours

Convert to minutes: (1/24) × 60 = 2.5 minutes × 60 = 150 seconds

X and Y will meet next after 150 sec.
